scope: XML utility reconciliation; original inventory + explicitly selected counterpart utility obligations

selection.excluded: OPC test_oxml is owned by package reconciliation. Table/drawing/chart/shape-specific XML rows retain feature ledgers; no utility BDD scenario directly exercises these internals, so no presentation BDD row is promoted.

notice: Original tests/assets. Existing standalone test-case-map-notice.txt and upstream-license-notice.txt retained. Source identities stay in research only.

language_security.J01: Input is explicit bytes; no path interpretation, network, runtime callback or ambient host filesystem.
language_security.J02: Immutable QName/child records and explicit array traversal replace descriptor and metaclass proxy identities; owned live view API remains governed by its separate receipts.
language_security.J05: Numeric XML is strictly decimal, finite and safe-integer bounded. Unit suffixes are lowercase in/mm/cm/pt/pc/pi; no hexadecimal or exponent syntax. Coordinate union permits decimal unit quantities; positive-coordinate extents remain integers. Percentage tokens accept signed decimals followed by percent and integer thousandths.
language_security.rounding: Universal measure conversion uses ties away from zero, consistent with existing Length arithmetic. Source uses ties to even. Exact +/-0.000125mm => +/-5 is an intentional explicit difference; no source tie variant existed.
language_security.null: Generic XML merge null means explicit attribute removal and missing raw attributes remain absent. A test-only schema required-attribute descriptor is not exposed as a product schema.
language_security.serialization: Whitespace, prefix spellings and attribute order are retained, rather than pretty-printing or using a line comparator. Invalid/incomplete namespace fragments fail.
language_security.error: Invalid lexical XML uses invalid-xml, generic structured-edit type failures preserve current invalid-value, direct absent integer lexical input uses invalid-type.
language_security.whitespace: Outer XML space/tab/CR/LF is trimmed before scalar parsing; internal whitespace and nonbreaking spaces are rejected. XML Schema whitespace collapse: https://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/#rf-whiteSpace
